caption: The drawing shows a detailed technical illustration of a wooden chair, depicted in both front and side views in black lines on a beige background. The front view displays the chair's tall, ornate backrest, which features a central rectangular panel with crosshatch shading, flanked by two vertical columns topped with finials. The upper part of the backrest has a decorative, scroll-like carving. The seat is rectangular, supported by four turned legs, with the front legs connected by a lower carved stretcher piece, also featuring ornamental scrollwork. The side view emphasizes the backward slant of the backrest and shows the side profile of the turned legs and horizontal stretchers. Several dimensions are marked: the backrest is 4 feet 1 and ½ inches tall; the front width of the chair is 17 and ½ inches; the seat height is 17 and ½ inches; the backrest width at its narrowest is 14 inches; the depth of the seat is 16 inches; and the overall depth at the base is 18 and ½ inches. The drawing includes finely rendered details such as turned legs, finials, and scrollwork, and the paper is slightly yellowed with a faint brown stain on the left side. The lower right corner contains the name "HARRY EISMAN" in small type.
title: Side Chair
